Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Hatcher
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 02/14/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 198 as introduced would authorize the quorum of a board of registrars of a county, subject to the written consent of the county commission, to reallocate unused working days from one registrar to another. This would decrease annual savings to the State General Fund and county general funds from salary expenses by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of unused working days that would now be reallocated from one registrar to another registrar.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs

Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Hatcher
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 02/18/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 198 as passed the Senate could increase the obligations of the State General Fund by approximately $86 for each day a registrar works due to a reallocation of working days, as provided by this bill, that otherwise would have been unused up to the maximum annual number of workings days currently provided by law.
This bill could further increase the obligations of the State General Fund by an undetermined amount dependent upon any additional mileage, travel, or other expenses reimbursed to the board due to the reallocation of working days provided by this bill.
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund
